newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian rouble hit by T-bill auction questions.
newsitem.headline: Russian rouble hit by T-bill auction questions.

text.p: Uncertainty about the rules of Wednesday's Russian Treasury bill auction hit the rouble on Monday and it weakened against the dollar to pre-weekend levels after firming earlier, traders said.
rouble/dollar Feb 3 midday Feb 3 early Jan 31 close
"If the Finance Ministry works out the rules, then the rouble can firm close to one edge of the corridor. If not it could go close to the other end," said one trader.
Russia has not worked out details of a new tax on T-bills which came into force a couple of weeks ago but has been delayed by the Finance Ministry and Central Bank by technical factors.
Little movement was expected on Monday afternoon, barring fresh news on rules for Wednesday's auction.
Optimistic banks sold dollars at slightly above-average levels in the morning in expectation of an early resolution of the issue but were disappointed later in the day, dealers said.

They predicted bank demand on Tuesday could spark an early rise in the rouble against the dollar but some said the move could be smaller than on Monday since banks had done most of their necessary positioning.
